name: Presence-anchored Cutie regional memory readout
status: Exploratory follow-up to experiment 92; no shuffled arm
motivation: The prior Cutie regional projection produced nonempty raw decoder masks but drove SAM2 object-presence scores below zero on severe failure frames. SAM2 then replaced those masks with its no-object value. This run tests a fixed teacher-consistency term on presence scores, not a new inference threshold.

method.regions: Frozen predicted-mask grid assignment: background, foreground interior, and mixed boundary cells.
method.regional_branch: Pinned Cutie regional summaries and pretrained CrossAttention, with the zero-initialized SAM2 output projection used in experiment 92.
method.loss: Author-compatible decoder mask loss + SAM2 object-presence loss + 1.0 * SmoothL1(regional object score, archived native SAM2 object score) on GT-present training frames only.
method.inference: No score threshold changes. Native encoder, memory writer, attention, decoder, pointers, frame schedule and all memory tokens are retained.
method.controls: Paired native SAM2 reference only. No shuffled condition, per user direction.

prior_work.regional_components: Reuses the same pinned Cutie ObjectSummarizer/CrossAttention components as experiment 92.
prior_work.training_signal: Uses SAM2's existing object-presence objective plus fixed consistency to archived native scores; no external learned component.

data.scope: Exploratory only: PolypGen has informed prior design and evaluation; seq16-seq23 are not untouched; patient independence is unverified.

training.anchor_selection: GT-present training targets only; the normal presence loss handles absent targets.

evaluation.primary: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice paired against archived native SAM2 on seq16-seq23.
evaluation.exploratory_meaningful_screen: At least +0.01 equal-sequence Dice, higher Dice on at least 6/8 sequences, and no increase in pooled false alarms on GT-empty frames.
evaluation.interpretation: Passing the exploratory screen is a candidate signal only and requires independent external confirmation and a prospectively specified second seed.
